events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent Mode in Excel
events.titleJa: Microsoft 365 Copilot の会議・チャット機能を更新
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Chat] Agent Mode in Excel
events.summary: Available for Microsoft 365 subscribers without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Agent Mode is releasing to Copilot in Excel for the web, Windows and Mac, enabling users to build and edit workbooks with Copilot using multi-step workflows. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data,...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit capability for selecting permission reading option for existing ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Connections
events.titleJa: 既存の ServiceNow ナレッジおよびカタログ接続の権限読み取りオプションを選択するための編集機能
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit capability for selecting permission reading option for existing ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Connections
events.summary: Earlier admins had to create new connections to adopt to the hierarchical permissions for ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Copilot Connectors as the edit capability was missing. Now, admins can easily edit their existing connections to switch between the permission handling option i.e. Simple vs Advanced to quickly...
events.summaryJa: 以前の管理者は、編集機能がなかったため、ServiceNow ナレッジおよびカタログ Copilot コネクタの階層アクセス許可を適用するために新しい接続を作成する必要がありました。現在、管理者は既存の接続を簡単に編集して、アクセス許可処理オプション (シンプルとアドバンス) をすばやく切り替えることができます。
events.summaryEn: Earlier admins had to create new connections to adopt to the hierarchical permissions for ServiceNow Knowledge & Catalog Copilot Connectors as the edit capability was missing. Now, admins can easily edit their existing connections to switch between the permission handling option i.e. Simple vs Advanced to quickly...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Teams Channels in Context IQ
events.titleJa: Context IQ の Teams チャネル
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Teams Channels in Context IQ
events.summary: Users will be able to search for and select Teams Channels in the Context IQ menu to help ground their prompts when using Copilot Chat.
events.summaryJa: ユーザーは、Context IQ メニューで Teams チャネルを検索して選択できるようになり、Copilot Chat を使用するときにプロンプトをしっかりと立てることができます。
events.summaryEn: Users will be able to search for and select Teams Channels in the Context IQ menu to help ground their prompts when using Copilot Chat.

events.titleJa: People Skills - E3/E5 ユーザー向けに拡張された AI 推論
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): People Skills - Expanded AI inferencing for E3/E5 users
events.summary: People Skills is expanding AI powered skill inferencing to include Microsoft 365 E3 and E5 licensed users. Previously, AI powered skill inferencing was available only to Microsoft 365 Copilot and Microsoft Viva licensed users. With this update, admins will have the option to turn on AI powered skill inferencing for...

events.summary: Copilot Chat can automatically create and open a Page side-by-side when it detects a relevant scenario, enabling instant editing, steering, and sharing.

events.title: OneDrive: Microsoft 365 Copilot in OneDrive
events.summary: We're excited to bring M365 Copilot in OneDrive, a new unified Copilot chat experience designed to make working with your files simpler, smarter, and more seamless across Microsoft 365.
events.summaryJa: Microsoft 365 全体でファイルの操作をよりシンプル、スマート、よりシームレスにするように設計された新しい統合された Copilot チャット エクスペリエンスである M365 Copilot を OneDrive に導入できることを嬉しく思います。
events.summaryEn: We're excited to bring M365 Copilot in OneDrive, a new unified Copilot chat experience designed to make working with your files simpler, smarter, and more seamless across Microsoft 365.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
events.titleJa: 増分クロールでサポート許可の同期が失われる
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
events.summary: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.
events.summaryJa: 以前は、アクセス許可は定期的なフル クロールでのみ同期されていました。通常、ほとんどのコネクタでは、デフォルトの頻度が 1 日でした。現在、増分的な方法でより頻繁に権限の同期を実行できるようになりました。
events.summaryEn: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.
